shots.section: 09 · A responsive world, one continuous route
shots.description: A low three-quarter wide holds her fully upright on the stone rim of the circular pool. Her LEFT arm reaches into the sky, the elbow softly curved and fingers opening towards the light; her RIGHT arm extends outward below shoulder height. A gentle turn through her waist and a softly bent knee give the pose an elegant, sensual line. Her chin lifts and her brown eyes follow the raised hand, lips slightly parted in absorbed wonder. Behind her, a colossal cobalt-violet current unfurls into a luminous helix across the dark sky, threading between distant floating ruins and suspended waterfalls. Amber arches frame the depth, while the pool reflects the same moving light. The navy dress has a clean, consistent mid-thigh hem, never a high hip slit. She stays grounded and composed as the whole world seems to answer that one small touch.
shots.angle: Low front three-quarter environmental wide; full figure left of centre, raised arm against the sky helix
shots.movement: One uninterrupted full 360° clockwise camera orbit over 3.731s: 28mm rectilinear, constant 4m radius, camera approximately 1.0m above the paving, constant shallow upward pitch and level roll. Keep the heroine at the same left-of-centre screen position and a constant full-figure size. Smooth constant angular speed ≈96.49°/s; strong parallax between nearby arches, distant islands and the luminous helix. No push-in, crane, zoom, speed ramp, horizon roll or internal cut. The camera circles; her body and the court stay fixed.

storyNotes: The dense metropolis descent reaches one weathered apartment window. She is already alone and returning briskly to the sofa, before the interior sit cut.

He has already left. She sits and folds forward, a tense grip lands on the first beat/vocal, composure gives way to one tear, then she hurries to wet a cloth, cools her cheek and ends the evening at the task-light switch.

The identical empty room shifts from May to August 2074. Her transformed workshop leads to a shelf rediscovery: her worn 2064 AI circuitry textbook and sophisticated older hobby project. A small successful connector test rekindles pleasure; she leaves it on the bench and hurries into the city, discovering AFTERIMAGE on Into view.

She enters the hardware market, unexpectedly meets her old friend, hugs him and accepts his invitation to see something new. He fits the prototype, activates it, and her abstract preview leads to taking the module home.

Returning from the market she finds her ex at the lift. They wait, enter, brush shoulders and exchange tentative looks. At his floor he exits; she stays. Her steady gaze and the closing doors are her answer.
A brief home ellipse shows the case put safely down and her changed for the arcade. She focuses on a solo race, then her friend arrives, offers reassurance and joins her for a two-player game.
The familiar apartment exterior now shows her working alone. A short sequence of competent finishing steps leads to a stable READY result and a clear pleased reaction.

Her tested build leads to eager preparation and supported immersion. After settling she closes her eyes with quiet bliss. One contact adjustment and one deliberate wrist press precede light across her closed eyelid. A single supported portrait remains still as architecture enters her perception; the physical chair never leaves the apartment.

The existing world arrival, leaf and circular-pool response lead into the approved grounded current turn. At03:44 the silver-dress theatre insert begins; from03:48 the final stage passage carries the declarations, two quiet direct-gaze lines and gentle instrumental views. The quiet final gaze leads into the existing world iris after its complete phrase.

After the complete quiet final stage repeat, steady eye contact matches into the original world iris. Fingers release, eyes close for a breath then reopen upward, and the preserved decisive ascent follows.
